# Getting help

GitHub shows this page when you open a new issue. Most questions have a faster answer than
waiting for a reply.

## Setting it up

[docs/usage.md](../docs/usage.md) covers building and installing the app, the first-run
setup, and getting data into Home Assistant step by step. [docs/features.md](../docs/features.md)
lists what the app can do, and [docs/webhook.md](../docs/webhook.md) what it sends.

## Something is not working

The [troubleshooting section](../docs/usage.md#troubleshooting) answers the questions that
come up most: background syncs that come late, a locked iPhone, a server at home that nothing
reaches, and MQTT sensors that do not update. The Logs tab in the app shows every delivery
attempt with the server's answer, which is usually enough to tell what went wrong.

## Still stuck, or want to ask something

The Android app's [Discussions](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-companion-app/discussions)
are the place for questions, setup help and ideas about either app; say that it is about the
iPhone. The answer stays findable for whoever asks next.

## Reporting a bug

If something is broken in the iPhone app, open an
[issue](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-companion-app-ios/issues/new/choose) here.
The template asks for the app and iOS version and for the log entry, because those usually
determine the cause.

Security problems go through
[private advisories](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-companion-app-ios/security/advisories/new)
instead, never a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
